svg.aria-label: Three graphs, for the terms J, H and G of the west stress on their intervals -2/3 to 2/5, -2/5 to 2/5 and 0 to 16/15: in blue four times the harmonic part, in orange the radical with R = 1.6886, and the gap between them shaded green; the blue curve lies above the orange one everywhere, with a corner at 0 for J and H
